yt_title: Day 3 of 10 — The Art Cupboard | Anaya's Ten Days EP08
short:
Three days left.

The art cupboard has everything nobody wants.
Gold foil. Ribbon. Two good sheets of card.

She stayed behind after everyone went home, and by the time the light went orange it was finished.

All that was left was his name.
cta:
And she stopped. She'd only ever called him Papa 🧡
EP9 tomorrow ✦
